module_role: AHCI Host Bus Adapter (HBA) — a PCI-class function that bridges system memory to up to 32 Serial ATA ports. Integrates a PCI / PCI-X / PCI-Express system-bus interface, a memory-mapped AHCI register block (ABAR = BAR5), a per-port DMA engine + Command List walker + Received-FIS poster + Task File shadow + interrupt aggregator, and an integrated SATA Transport / Link / PHY macro per port. AHCI is the host-side counterpart of an SATA storage device (HDD / SSD / ODD).

integration_overview.ahci_register_base: ABAR = PCI BAR5 (PCI cfg offset 24h); maps a non-cacheable memory region containing Generic Host Control + per-port banks + Vendor Specific area.
integration_overview.system_memory_role: HBA acts as a bus master to system memory to fetch Command Headers / Command Tables / PRDs and to post Received FISes / Data.
integration_overview.no_chip_select: Each port has its own dedicated SATA differential pair pair; no shared bus, no chip-select.
integration_overview.controller_role: HBA initiates every SATA transaction (host-master); device only responds (except for asynchronous notification on Set Device Bits FIS).
integration_overview.no_handshake_per_byte: FIS framing + 32-bit CRC + X_RDY/R_RDY/R_OK/R_ERR primitive handshake replace per-byte handshake.

interface_categories: System bus (PCI / PCI-X / PCI-Express) — control + DMA traffic to system memory.
Memory-mapped AHCI register block behind ABAR (BAR5) — software-visible programming interface.
Optional Enclosure Management buffer (EM_LOC / EM_CTL) for SES-2 / SAF-TE / SGPIO / LED messages.
Optional Cold Presence Detect input / Mechanical Presence Switch input.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single host + single direct-attached SATA device (one port).
Single host + N ports (each direct-attached, 1-32 devices total).
Single host + Port Multiplier on one or more ports (Command-Based Switching).
Single host + Port Multiplier with FIS-Based Switching (HBA tracks 16 concurrent device contexts per port).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: On HBA reset, GHC.HR=1 forces all state machines to idle; GHC.AE = CAP.SAM (RO 1 if SAM=1, else 0); IS=0; per-port PxCMD.ST=0, PxCMD.FRE=0, PxCMD.SUD = (CAP.SSS=1 ? 0 : 1), PxCI=0, PxSACT=0, PxSCTL.DET=0, PxSCTL.IPM=0, PxSCTL.SPD=0. The SATA link starts in Phy-not-established state (PxSSTS.DET=0); software must set PxCMD.SUD=1 to drive Staggered Spin-Up if applicable.
soc_dependent_items: Integrated SATA PHY macro per port (Gen 1/2/3 capable, with on-chip TX de-emphasis + RX equalization + CDR).
Reference clock distribution to all port PHYs (typically 100 MHz or 25 MHz × PLL multiplier).
System-bus controller for register / DMA traffic (PCI / PCI-X / PCIe bridge).
DMA engine integration with system-memory subsystem (cache coherency, IOMMU translation if present).
Interrupt controller integration (legacy INTx + MSI / MSI-X).
Activity LED driver per port (when CAP.SAL=1).
DEVSLP sideband output driver per port (when CAP2.SDS=1).
Enclosure Management buffer storage + drive logic (SGPIO output train, when CAP.EMS=1).
Cold Presence Detect / Mechanical Presence Switch input conditioning.
Optional PCI Expansion ROM for legacy BIOS boot support.
Optional NVMHCI register block at offset 60h-9Fh (when CAP2.NVMP=1).

pull_up_resistors.purpose: Keep sideband in defined LOW state when HBA tristates the line.

low_power_modes.Active: L0 link state; PxSSTS.IPM=1h; all FIS traffic possible.
low_power_modes.Partial: Low-power link state; receiver maintains COMRESET / COMINIT detection; exit latency ≤ 10 µs (typical).
low_power_modes.Slumber: Lower-power link state; longer exit latency ≤ 10 ms (typical).
low_power_modes.DevSleep: Lowest-power link state — PHY can be powered down; entered by host asserting DEVSLP sideband HIGH; exit governed by PxDEVSLP.DETO; PxSSTS.IPM=8h.
low_power_modes.Aggressive_Link_PM: PxCMD.ALPE + PxCMD.ASP cause the HBA to auto-issue PMREQ_P / PMREQ_S when the port goes idle.
low_power_modes.Aggressive_DevSleep: PxDEVSLP.ADSE + CAP2.SADM cause the HBA to auto-assert DEVSLP after PxDEVSLP.DITO idle timeout.
low_power_modes.HBA_D3_HOT: Host PCI Power Management transitions HBA to D3HOT — register memory space inaccessible; configuration space accessible; interrupts blocked.

compatibility_notes: AHCI 1.3.1 is backward compatible with AHCI 1.0 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 at the register and FIS level — VS register reports the implemented major.minor version.
Legacy SFF-8038i Bus Master IDE register set may coexist (CAP.SAM=0); software selects mode via GHC.AE.
PCI Class Code 0x010601 identifies AHCI 1.x silicon; Class Code 0x010401 identifies RAID — same silicon may switch via vendor mode bits.
Port Multiplier devices (signature 0xC33C0101) appear behind a single AHCI port; up to 15 SATA devices per Port Multiplier.
ATAPI devices (signature 0xEB140101) require PxCMD.ATAPI=1 + Command Header A=1 + ACMD region populated.
AHCI Version 0.95 / 1.0 / 1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.3.1 share the same memory layout; new features (DevSleep, BOHC, CCC, EM, FBS) are opt-in via CAP / CAP2 bits.
